search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1347178 (Vanda Pharmaceuticals) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched the exhibits of every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2010-01 to 2026-09.

Rows read from the HETLIOZ net product sales line of the condensed consolidated statements of operations in each quarterly earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, thousands); the guidance table rows of the same releases ('HETLIOZ net product sales | $x to $y million') carry no single figure and are skipped. Where January preliminary-revenue 8-Ks (2017-01-09, 2018-01-08) map to the same fourth quarter as the February earnings release, the later earnings release is used. The 2014Q2 release prints the prior-year quarter as a dash, so 2014Q2 is the first quarter of sales. The quarter is confirmed by the prior-year comparative column.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 45 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
